subject.title: fix(cli): warn that attach --print-config prints a live bearer token

question: Should `openclaw attach --print-config` retain its live-token stdout contract with this unconditional stderr warning, or should OpenClaw require a log-safe/redacted output path before accepting the mitigation?
rationale: The code preserves a compatibility-sensitive CLI handoff contract while handling live bearer material; the repository evidence identifies several viable product and security tradeoffs, but does not establish which long-term policy maintainers intend.

options.title: Accept warning-only mitigation
options.body: Keep the existing stdout JSON contract, land the stderr warning after redacted live command proof confirms the stream behavior.

options.title: Add an opt-in log-safe mode
options.body: Preserve existing `--print-config` output while defining a separate redacted or summary mode for logs and reports.

options.title: Redesign secret output
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a new default that avoids emitting the token directly, with explicit compatibility and migration review.

recommendation.title: Accept warning-only mitigation
recommendation.body: Keep the existing stdout JSON contract, land the stderr warning after redacted live command proof confirms the stream behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion specifically asks this person to resolve the credential-output policy.
